title: Re-registration of a Named Lift Ticket Holder
content:
A Lift Tickets product sold to a named holder may be re-registered to another person where the product allows it, against the product's re-registration fee, and only before the first day is scanned. A product that is transferable between guests needs no re-registration at all, because whoever holds the media may ski on it.

| How the product is sold | What passing it to another person requires |
| --- | --- |
| Sold to a named holder, where the product allows re-registration | Re-registration to that other person, against the product's re-registration fee, before the first day is scanned |
| Transferable between guests | Nothing: an unused day may be used by whoever holds the media |

## The point at which re-registration closes

Re-registration stands only before the first day is scanned. An order on which a day has already been drawn has passed that point, and the person named on it is the person it remains registered to for the rest of its life. The limit is drawn at the first scan rather than at the issue of the media, so an order whose media has been issued and collected but never scanned has not yet passed that point.
